title: Vietnam-region chlorophyll and monsoon winds
query: Using the provided MODIS-Aqua and NOAA blended wind data for May–September 2004–2012 off Vietnam (109–112°E, 10–16°N), investigate how summer chlorophyll variability relates to monsoon winds.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
